source: Three user-supplied PDFs, described by user as JLC official supply options; final grade randomly one of these three

materials.name: 上海南亚 NY2140
materials.explanation: Provided PDF is only MSDS. Manufacturer official product table supplies Dk/Df for R/C 55% and 70%; actual JLC order construction unknown. Both values held constant for 2.4 GHz conditional simulations.

materials.name: 台湾南亚 NP-140F
materials.explanation: Use midpoints of the 1 GHz typical ranges, held constant for 2.4 GHz calculation. Not a manufacturer-confirmed 2.4 GHz value. 1 MHz rows are not substituted for the 1 GHz rows.

materials.name: 航宇 HY-8101
materials.explanation: Page1 typical Dk4.3, Df0.022; table does not explicitly state frequency. Page2 Dk plot covers only 1-100 MHz (RC42%), not GHz; no 2.4 GHz extrapolation formula supplied. Values held constant and applied to 1.6 mm PCB as an approximation.

simulation.loss_model: Dk constant; conductivity fixed using 2*pi*2.45GHz*EPS0*Dk*Df. Effective tan(delta) varies inversely with frequency, not a fitted material dispersion model.
simulation.reference_plane: L220 antenna-side pad; 50 ohm port, not chip ANT

known_gaps: NY2140 actual resin content and glass-cloth construction for JLC 1.6 mm boards unknown; two manufacturer R/C examples are not guaranteed extrema
No supplied PDF gives measured parameters at 2.4 GHz
Neither material ranges nor lot-to-lot variation have been exhaustively bounded
Actual shell dielectric and fully populated assembly remain unverified
